statistical_limits: Average images within each model then average matched training seeds. Bootstrap resamples paired images after averaging seeds; intervals condition on the observed seeds and do not measure population-level training randomness. Single-seed repair remains a pilot. Multiple comparisons are descriptive, not confirmatory significance tests. Gate aliases are reused exactly, not independent runs.
